div.head: Af 11.1
div.ab: Gif he oferweorpe hy ⁊ mid ne gehæme, mid X scll' gebete.
Gif he hie oferweorpe ⁊ mid ne gehæme, mid X scill. gebete.
Si supinet eam nec tamen concumbat cum ea, decem sol. emendetur.
Gif he oferweorpe ⁊ mid ne gehæme, mid X scill gebete.
If he throws her down but does not have intercourse with her, let him recompense with 10 shillings.
If he throws her down but does not lie with her, he shall pay [her] 10 shillings compensation.
Wenn er sie niederwirft, jedoch nicht beschläft, büsse er mit 10 Schill.
If he throws her down, but does not lie with her, let him pay 10 shillings.
